description: One caller turn for the offline ECHO slice. The WAV is committed telephony-style PCM. Mock STT replays utterance.transcript as streaming partials while the audio is voiced, then as the final transcript at endpoint. It is not acoustic speech recognition.

utterance.speaker: caller
utterance.transcript: Hi, I need to reschedule my appointment for Thursday.

fixedReply: I can help you reschedule that. What time works on Thursday?

provenance.text: Hi, I need to reschedule my appointment for Thursday.
provenance.note: Running the slice does not require espeak-ng, ffmpeg, or an API key. The WAV in this directory is the fixture.
